import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'benchmarks'))
from harness.factor import _gf_cases, PolyMojo
from harness.generate import cyclic, noon
from harness.polys import make, write_records
from profile_support import summarize
folder = root / '.cache/simd-survey'
report = {'scope': 'Whole-process SIGPROF PC self samples; nominal 1 ms process CPU interval. Inlined callees are attributed to enclosing symbols. Instrumented timings are not performance comparisons.', 'revision': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(), 'results': []}

def run(name, binary, args, work):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['LD_PRELOAD'] = str(root / '.cache/cad-native-simd/sample_pc.so')
    env['CAD_NATIVE_PROFILE'] = str(work / 'samples.txt')
    command = [str(binary), *args]
    print('START', name, flush=True)
    with (work/'stdout').open('w') as out, (work/'stderr').open('w') as err:
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err, check=True, timeout=60, preexec_fn=lambda: os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0}))
    profile = summarize(work / 'samples.txt')
    item = {'case': name, 'command': command, 'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256((work/'input.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'profile':profile}
    for row in profile['functions'][:12]:
        print(round(row['percent'],2), row['symbol'][:150], flush=True)
    report['results'].append(item)
    return item

for case in _gf_cases():
    if case['size'] != 500: continue
    work = folder / case['id']; work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    tool = PolyMojo(binary=folder/'dense-factor')
    cmd = tool.prepare(case, work, {'min_seconds':5,'min_reps':3})
    item = run(case['id'], Path(cmd[0]), cmd[1:], work)
    answer = tool.collect(case, work)['answer']
    p = case['modulus']; product = [int(answer['unit'])]
    for coeffs, exponent in answer['factors']:
        coeffs = list(map(int,coeffs))
        for _ in range(exponent):
            out = [0] * (len(product)+len(coeffs)-1)
            for i,a in enumerate(product):
                for j,b in enumerate(coeffs):out[i+j] = (out[i+j]+a*b)%p
            product = out
    assert product == [int(x)%p for x in case['poly']]
    item['product_check'] = True
    (folder/'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

for name,gen in [('cyclic-5-gf65521-lex',cyclic),('noon-5-gf65521-lex',noon)]:
    n, terms = gen(5)
    work = folder / name; work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (work/'input.txt').write_text(write_records([make(t,65521) for t in terms],n,65521))
    item = run(name, folder/'groebner-gf5', ['input.txt','answer.txt','result.json','lex','comparable','65521','5','3'], work)
    item['basis_length'] = json.loads((work/'result.json').read_text())['basis_length']
    item['external_basis_check'] = False
    (folder/'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('DONE',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import collections,json,re,subprocess
folder=Path('.cache/simd-survey');report=[]
for name in ['dense-factor','groebner-gf5']:
 p=folder/name
 if not p.exists():continue
 rows=subprocess.check_output(['nm','-S','-n','-C','--defined-only',str(p)],text=True)
 for line in rows.splitlines():
  bits=line.split(maxsplit=3)
  if len(bits)!=4 or bits[2].lower() not in ['t','w']:continue
  sym=bits[3]
  if not any(s in sym for s in ['_nmod::_divmod_classic','_nmod::_dot[','_nmod::_Spectral::forward','_nmod::_Spectral::back','_Forms[','_fglm::_fglm[','_nmod_euclid::_Field::combine']):continue
  if '_Forms[' in sym and '::multiply' not in sym:continue
  start=int(bits[0],16);size=int(bits[1],16)
  asm=subprocess.check_output(['objdump','-d','--no-show-raw-insn',f'--start-address={start}',f'--stop-address={start+size}',str(p)],text=True)
  opcodes=collections.Counter()
  for row in asm.splitlines():
   m=re.match(r'\s*[0-9a-f]+:\s+(\S+)',row)
   if m:opcodes[m[1]]+=1
  report.append({'binary':name,'symbol':sym,'start':start,'size':size,'instructions':dict(opcodes)})
  print(name,sym[:150],size, {k:v for k,v in opcodes.items() if k.startswith(('vpmul','vpadd','vpsub','vpcmp','mul','imul','div'))})
  (folder/f'assembly-{name}-{start:x}.txt').write_text(asm)
(folder/'assembly.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
